rule.statistic: median share over the 35 source cities, validation block, leave-one-city-out
rule.fit: highest at level local among all earlier-model versions (Kwon included)
rule.zero_shot: highest at level uniform among the versions that do not need the city's own trips (Kwon excluded)
rule.fit_original: as fit, among the as-published versions only (population mass, and Kwon)
rule.zero_shot_original: as zero_shot, among the as-published versions only
rule.ties: fewer free parameters, then the name
